description: Renovate is disabled for this repository. build.gradle uses Gradle's removed jetty plugin and the removed compile/testCompile configurations, so the build cannot run on any current Gradle regardless of dependency versions, and the only check configured here is Snyk, which does not build anything.

The dependency versions were brought current before disabling: javax.ws.rs-api 2.1.1 and the Jersey monorepo at 2.48, the last line that keeps the javax.ws.rs namespace this source uses. Jersey 3 and 4 move to jakarta.ws.rs, which is a source change rather than a version bump, so PR #5 was closed rather than merged.
